ns2:section.sectionText: Saturday 9am-1pm with exceptions for survey techniques being taught when hours may change (e.g., evening surveys). This course will introduce students to the variety of techniques used to study mammalian ecology and conservation. We will focus on trapping, surveying, and monitoring mammals in Illinois. Field trips will provide students with hands-on experience of commonly used field techniques. Students will be responsible for their own field-appropriate clothing. Lectures will be kept to a minimum before and after each field trip. This section will have a field trip fee of $90. Once all seats in the course are filled, you can add yourself to the waiting list by completing the form at http://go.illinois.edu/NRESwaitinglist.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Natural Resrcs & Environ Sci major(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
